records.quote: In the sequel, we show that, if the network has a series structure, then the reliability of the network in the GCP model dominates the reliability of the network in an NHPP model. ... If ϑ1,NP and ϑ1,GP denote the arrival times of the first component failure based on NHPP and GCP, respectively, then, from inequality e^x > (1 + x), x > 0, we can write P(ϑ1,NP > t) = e^{−Λ(t)} < 1/(1 + Λ(t)) = P(ϑ1,GP > t). Hence, based on the fact that, for a series network s = (1, 0, ..., 0), relation (2) implies that TNP ≤st TGP.
